FREELANCE DESIGN SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Freelance Design Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on the date of the last signature below (the "Effective Date") between Larkspur Pantry Cooperative LLC, of 18 Orchard Row, Portland, Oregon (the "Client"), and Juniper Fold Studio LLC, of 7 Cedar Lane, Eugene, Oregon (the "Designer"). The Client and the Designer are each a "Party" and together the "Parties".

SECTION 1 - THE PROJECT

The Client engages the Designer to create a brand identity for the Client's new grocery delivery service (the "Project"). The Project consists of the deliverables listed in Schedule A (the "Deliverables"): a primary logo with two variations, a colour palette, a typography guide, and templates for social media posts and delivery labels.

The Designer will deliver first concepts within three weeks of receiving the Client's signed Agreement and deposit. The Parties will agree the remaining milestones in writing once the Client has selected a concept.

Any work outside the Deliverables listed in Schedule A is out of scope. If the Client asks for out-of-scope work, the Designer will send a written estimate, and the Designer will not begin that work until the Client approves the estimate in writing.

SECTION 2 - FEES AND PAYMENT

The Client shall pay the Designer a fixed fee of USD 6,000 for the Project, invoiced as half on signature of this Agreement and half on delivery of the final Deliverables. The Client shall pay each invoice in full within fifteen days of the invoice date.

Payment is made by bank transfer to the account shown on the invoice. Each Party bears its own bank charges.

Invoices not paid when due accrue a late fee of one percent per month on the unpaid balance until paid. If an invoice remains unpaid thirty days after its due date, the Designer may pause work on the Project after giving the Client seven days' written notice, and any agreed deadlines move by the length of the pause.

The Client will reimburse reasonable expenses that it has approved in writing in advance, such as licensed stock imagery or font licences bought specifically for the Project. The Designer will include receipts with any invoice for expenses.

SECTION 3 - REVISIONS

The fee includes two rounds of revisions per Deliverable, and any further revisions will be billed at the hourly rate of USD 90. A round of revisions means one consolidated set of written comments from the Client on a Deliverable, followed by one revised version from the Designer.

The Client will give its comments on each round within ten business days. If the Client does not respond within that time, the Designer may treat the Deliverable as approved after sending a reminder and waiting a further five business days.

SECTION 4 - CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES

The Client will provide the information, existing brand materials and feedback the Designer reasonably needs to complete the Project. The Client will name one person to give consolidated feedback and approvals on its behalf.

The Client confirms that any materials it supplies to the Designer, including photographs, text and existing logos, are owned by the Client or used with permission.

SECTION 5 - INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

Ownership of the copyright in each final Deliverable transfers to the Client upon the Client's payment in full of the fees for that Deliverable. Until that payment is made, the Designer grants the Client a limited licence to use the Deliverables for internal review only.

Concepts, sketches and drafts that the Client does not select remain the property of the Designer. The Designer keeps ownership of its pre-existing tools, methods, templates and know-how, and grants the Client a perpetual, non-exclusive licence to use any of them that are built into the final Deliverables, solely as part of those Deliverables.

Where a Deliverable includes third-party material such as a licensed font, the Client's rights in that material are governed by the relevant licence, which the Designer will identify on delivery.

SECTION 6 - CONFIDENTIALITY

Each Party will keep confidential any non-public information the other Party shares in connection with the Project, and will use it only for the Project. This obligation does not apply to information that is already public, that the receiving Party already knew, or that the law requires it to disclose.

The confidentiality obligations in this Section continue for two years after this Agreement ends.

SECTION 7 - TERM AND TERMINATION

This Agreement starts on the Effective Date and ends when the Client has paid for the final Deliverables, unless it is terminated earlier under this Section.

Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason by giving the other Party fourteen days' written notice. Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the other Party materially breaches it and does not fix the breach within ten days of being asked to.

If either party terminates this Agreement, the Client shall pay the Designer for all work performed up to the effective date of termination at the hourly rate of USD 90, and the first invoice paid on signature is non-refundable. The amount owed on termination will not exceed the total fixed fee.

On termination, the Designer will deliver to the Client all work completed and paid for, and ownership of that work transfers to the Client in accordance with Section 5.

SECTION 8 - WARRANTIES

The Designer warrants that the Deliverables will be its own original work, except for third-party material identified on delivery, and that to the Designer's knowledge they will not infringe anyone else's copyright.

The Designer does not guarantee that any logo or name can be registered as a trade mark, and the Client is responsible for any trade mark searches or registrations it wants to carry out.

SECTION 9 - LIABILITY

Each Party's total liability to the other under this Agreement is limited to the total fees payable under this Agreement. Neither Party is liable to the other for any indirect or consequential loss, including loss of profit.

The limits in this Section do not apply to a Party's liability for fraud, or for any liability that cannot be limited by law.

SECTION 10 - INDEMNITIES

The Designer will indemnify the Client against third-party claims that a final Deliverable infringes that third party's copyright, and the Client will indemnify the Designer against third-party claims arising from materials the Client supplied. Each indemnity in this Section is subject to the liability limit in Section 9.

A Party seeking to rely on an indemnity must tell the other Party promptly about the claim, allow the other Party to control its defence, and give reasonable help at the other Party's cost.

SECTION 11 - RELATIONSHIP OF THE PARTIES

The Designer is an independent contractor. Nothing in this Agreement makes the Designer an employee, partner or agent of the Client. The Designer is responsible for its own taxes, insurance and working hours, and may work for other clients during and after the Project.

The Designer may use subcontractors for parts of the Project with the Client's written approval, which the Client will not unreasonably withhold. The Designer remains responsible for any subcontractor's work.

SECTION 12 - DISPUTES AND GOVERNING LAW

If a dispute arises, the Parties will first try in good faith to settle it by talking to each other for at least fourteen days. If they cannot settle it, either Party may bring the dispute before the state or federal courts located in Oregon.

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon.

SECTION 13 - GENERAL

Any change to this Agreement must be made in writing and signed by both Parties. Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other Party's written consent, which will not be unreasonably withheld.

This Agreement, including Schedule A, is the entire agreement between the Parties about the Project and replaces any earlier proposals or discussions about it.

If any part of this Agreement is found to be unenforceable, the rest of it continues in effect. Notices under this Agreement may be sent by email to the addresses each Party gives below, and are treated as received on the next business day.

Sections 5, 6, 9 and 10 continue to apply after this Agreement ends.

SCHEDULE A - DELIVERABLES

One primary logo, supplied as vector and raster files.
Two logo variations: a stacked version and a single-colour mark.
A colour palette of up to six colours, with print and screen values.
A two-page typography guide.
Five social media post templates.
Two delivery label templates.
